title: 将漫画人物融入你的真人照片
prompt: A photograph of a crowded subway train in Tokyo, hyper-realistic style. Sitting on one of the seats is a 2D black-and-white manga illustration of a tired samurai. The character is drawn with clean ink lines and cross-hatching shading. The lighting from the subway car hits the 2D drawing correctly, creating realistic highlights on the ink. The character holds a real photographic soda can, blending the 2D and 3D worlds. 4k, cinematic composition.
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 模型，将你的真人照片与动漫风格角色完美融合，适合打造独特的社交媒体内容、个性化头像或娱乐设计中的艺术项目。清晰的肖像和生动的提示词能带来最佳融合效果。
